reading: In November, four planets will appear in a line in the sky before sunrise.
They are Mercury, Venus, Mars and Jupiter.
You can see these planets without a telescope.
Mercury will be the hardest planet to see.
Venus is very bright, so it is easy to find.
Venus will be higher in the sky than Mercury.
Mars and Jupiter will look very close together on 15 and 16 November.
Choose a place away from bright lights, with a clear view towards the east.
Wait about twenty minutes so your eyes can get used to the dark.
The best time to look is about 45 to 60 minutes before sunrise.

vocabulary.definition: With nothing in the way to stop you seeing.
A little more or less than a number.
